{{Infobox auto}}
'''Fish bones''' are a [[fishing junk]] item. They are a {{MCW|Bone|bone}} with a different name and texture, so they work anywhere a bone does, for example crafting [[Bone Meal|bone meal]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
* The junk table lists them at 10 of 78 weight in most biomes (12.82% of junk, about 1.28% of all catches), but in 1.12.4 that table can't be loaded, so they can't be caught as junk (see [[Fishing junk]] and [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* 90.91% of the Sulfur Caves table, 41.77% of catches in Sulfur Caves. This is the only way to fish them in 1.12.4.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>

Catching them plays their own [[fishing sounds|sound]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Fish bones from Sulfur Caves now have the correct texture, so they stack with fish bones from the junk table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.4|Junk fish bones come from their own loot table, <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>. That table gives an {{MCW|Ender Pearl|ender pearl}} with the fish bones name and model instead of a bone (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>}}
}}
